messages.subject: Insulated Milkweed Phone Case
messages.text:
Hi Lasclay,
 

 RE: ORDER L-43579 
 
 
 I just received the order I placed earlier in December. The mitts look great. 
 However I am puzzled with the “electronic device sleeve”. I had ordered the “insulated Milkweed Phone Case” from your website. I see now on my order confirmation that a different product photo and description is on the email. The electronic device sleeve i received is too large for my intended purpose, which was to carry my phone outside in the winter. The device sleeve you sent is much differently made compared with the description on your website, with respect to seams (unfinished), closure (magnetic, not a zipper), attachment loops (none), and especially size: 11’x9” instead of the website description size of 5”x9”. 
 
 
 For these reasons, I would like to return this item. 
 
 
 Cindy 
 

 
 Cindy Presant, Artist

Hello Cindy,
 

 Just to confirm that we have received your message and will respond as soon as possible. We are currently receiving a higher number of requests than usual, but we are doing everything we can to process them quickly.
 

 We haven't forgotten about you! We are taking care of you and you will receive a response shortly. 🙂
 

 See you soon!
 

 Warmest regards,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
